newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mycogen EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mycogen EPS view cut.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Tuesday she lowered her earnings estimate for Mycogen Corp for fiscal 1997 to a loss of $0.34 a share from a loss of $0.22.
-- Her fiscal 1998 estimate remains a loss of $0.05 a share. In fiscal 1996, the company's loss was $0.85 a share.
-- Dain's rating on Mycogen remains a buy, "not based on short-term results. Rather it is based on Mycogen's technology base and growth potential."
-- Mycogen reported third quarter earnings of $0.30 a share before a charge of $0.28, below the consensus of $0.33.
-- "We believe it is reasonable to chase this stock into the high $20's or low $30's," Wittenburg said in a report.
